WITH department_counts AS (
  SELECT m.department, COUNT(DISTINCT mem.member_id) AS member_count
  FROM income AS i
  JOIN member AS mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member
  JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
  GROUP BY m.department
),
shares AS (
  SELECT department, member_count,
         CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM department_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT member_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(member_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share)
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share
